what: N at chapter 1's gate: leave a note; read it back from the fold; then open the HUD's Usage panel and read its totals, by-purpose rows and recent calls

actions.eval: (() => { const f = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-layer=notes] input')].find(x => (x.closest('label')?.innerText ?? '').includes('your note')); if (!f) return 'no field'; f.focus(); return document.activeElement === f })()

actions.type: A: Bram keeps the pier posts in sight; three freight kites are late.

actions.eval: (() => { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=notes]'); return l ? l.innerText.slice(0, 800) : 'no notes layer' })()

(async () => { const H = await import('/history/index.ts'); const n = H.worldNow(); return JSON.stringify({ head: n.head, notes: (n.notes ?? []).map(x => ({ n: x.n, author: x.author.slice(0, 10), text: x.body.text, coord: x.body.coord })) }) })()

(() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-usage-purpose]')].map(r => r.dataset.usagePurpose + ' | ' + r.innerText.replace(/\s+/g, ' ')); const t = document.body.innerText; const at = t.indexOf('AI usage'); return { rows, panel: at < 0 ? 'no panel' : t.slice(at, at + 2500) } })()
